title: Alteration Credit Posted with a Finch Circle Card Floor — Computation Clause
content:
**Scope.** For a card floor of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program this policy handles, and only for such a tier change, the alteration credit top-up posted on the change date is the floor top-up worked out below; a top-up after an upgrade or any other tier change remains under the base alteration credit rule, and nothing is taken back after a downgrade.

**Computation clause.**

1. *Floor card.* The floor card is the active card that grants the floor: an active World Elite Mastercard when the customer holds one, otherwise an active Store Card Elite, otherwise an active Platinum Mastercard.
2. *Floor top-up.* The floor top-up is the floor credit gap, plus the floor goodwill credit, plus the floor card spend allowance times the floor allowance standing share, plus the floor tailoring allowance, plus the floor bridal allowance, plus the floor apparel allowance, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.
3. *Floor credit gap.* The annual alteration credit of the floor tier (100.00 for Finch Circle Platinum, 50.00 for Finch Circle Gold) less the alteration credit balance the membership already holds, never below zero.
4. *Floor goodwill credit.* Counted on the days from the date the floor card account was opened to the change date: 25.00 when they run more than 365 calendar days, 15.00 when more than 180 and up to 365 days, 10.00 when more than 90 and up to 180 days, and 0.00 otherwise.
5. *Other values.* The floor allowance standing share is none (0). The floor card spend allowance, the floor tailoring allowance, the floor bridal allowance and the floor apparel allowance are 0.00.

| Days from the floor card account's opened date to the change date | Floor goodwill credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 366 or more | 25.00 |
| 181 to 365 | 15.00 |
| 91 to 180 | 10.00 |
| 90 or fewer | 0.00 |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Case | Floor tier | Credit balance held | Floor credit gap | Days since the floor card was opened | Goodwill | Floor top-up |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Active World Elite Mastercard and active Store Card Elite (World Elite comes first) | Finch Circle Platinum | 30.00 | 70.00 | 730 | 25.00 | 95.00 |
| Active Platinum Mastercard only | Finch Circle Gold | 60.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) | 200 | 15.00 | 15.00 |
| Active Store Card Elite only | Finch Circle Gold | 0.00 | 50.00 | 90 | 0.00 | 50.00 |

**Rounding.** The total is rounded half up to the cent once, after the additions; no part is rounded on its own.
